main.description: Attesting that I the user claim a given record over on a knot! A knot will claim that I wrote something, but it's only really tied to me if I too say that I wrote it. The 'change' field is literally the Git Object ID of the Collaborative Object (COB) change that made the knot-side record.

change.description: The Git Object ID of the COB change that made the knot-side record.
